name: atlas-research-console
description: ATLAS — a deep-research AI console powered by a transformer trained from scratch in pure JavaScript.

scripts.pipeline: npm run corpus && npm run train && npm run train:router && npm run index
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.smoke: npx --yes esbuild@0.24 scripts/ssr-smoke.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --loader:.css=empty --outfile=web/.ssr.cjs && node web/.ssr.cjs && rm -f web/.ssr.cjs
